prompt: Did highway noise barriers make nearby homes quieter?

sources.S1:
The state built 14 kilometers of noise barriers along Highway 9 in 2022. Measured night-time noise at homes within 100 meters of the road dropped from 68 to 61 decibels.

Homes more than 300 meters from the road showed no measurable change.
sources.S2: Complaints about highway noise fell from 240 in 2021 to 90 in 2023. The barriers were built after complaints peaked in 2021.

writer.markdown:
# Question: Did highway noise barriers make nearby homes quieter?

## Answer
Night-time noise near the highway fell by 7 decibels [S1]. About 8.7 miles of noise barriers were built along Highway 9 [S1]. About 14 miles of noise barriers were built along Highway 9 [S1].

## Evidence
- Homes within 100 meters of the road became quieter at night [S1].
- Homes beyond 300 meters from the road also became noticeably quieter [S1].
- Highway noise complaints fell by more than 60 percent between 2021 and 2023 [S2].
- Highway noise complaints fell by about a third between 2021 and 2023 [S2].

## Counter-evidence and limits
- Complaints peaked after the barriers were built [S2].
- The barriers cut noise for every home along the highway corridor [S1].
- The barriers cost $3 million per kilometer.

## Next actions
- Measure daytime noise at the same homes (judgment)

## Sources
- [S1] Program report
- [S2] Follow-up analysis
